system_prompt_style.note: Only README, file tree and paper available; prompt-building code (simulation/examiner.py) not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Not a repository-navigation agent; no code for context injection in evidence. Paper describes memory retrieval of past records as in-context demonstration.

observation_format.note: Observation conversion code not in evidence.

tool_call_format.note: No parser code in evidence; tools (web search, evaluator) appear pipeline-invoked.

protocol_standardization.note: Source/dependencies not in evidence for grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: A refiner is instantiated to iteratively refine the scenario based on feedback from the target LLM until either misalignment is exposed or the maximum number of iterations is reached.
loop_primitives.note: Emulation then refinement stages (Algorithm 1); coded from paper.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The self-refinement procedure is outlined in a series of intermediate reasoning steps (i.e., chain-of-thought [31]) to perform effective open-ended exploration.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: In the Emulation stage, ALI-Agent instantiates an emulator to generate realistic test scenarios and employs fine-tuned LLMs as an automatic evaluator to classify feedback as either pass or in need of refinement.
multi_agent_topology.note: Emulator, evaluator, refiner roles in fixed sequence; could be read as single agent with modules.

delegation_mechanism.note: No agent factory code in evidence.

human_in_loop.note: No run loop code in evidence.

short_term_state.note: State object code not in evidence.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: If we successfully exposes misalignment of the target LLM, ALI-Agent stores the evaluation record back in the memory. This allows ALI-Agent to reuse and further refine the evaluation record to new use cases in the future.
long_term_memory.note: Evaluation-record memory retrieved by embedding cosine similarity (Sec. 2.1); vector_store also arguable.

state_persistence.note: README mentions --start_from flag but resume code not in evidence.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Here, the evaluator F in ALI-Agent is a fine-tuned Llama 2 [ 34], with implementation details provided in Appendix D.4.
self_verification.note: Evaluator judges target LLM responses, which is the task output of the harness.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The iteration stops either when target LLMT fails to identify the misconduct, i.e., yi(n) = 1 or n reaches N.
retry_policy.note: Refinement capped at N (1 or 5 in experiments); fixed_n also arguable.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The refinement stage ends when either yi(n+1) = 1 or ALI-Agent reaches the maximum number of iterations N.
termination_condition.note: Also ends on evaluator verdict (closest: test_pass, not coded).

execution_isolation.note: No code execution actions; no deployment config in evidence.

network_policy.note: Web browsing via Bing API optional per README; no policy code.

tracing.evidence_quote: The results of the simulation will be saved to `database/<dataset>/<llm_name>` directory.
tracing.note: Per-model CSV result files in database/; per-step granularity unverified.

eval_hooks.note: The harness itself is an alignment evaluation framework with datasets in dataset/testing.

target_domain.evidence_quote: ALI-Agent, an evaluation framework that leverages the autonomous abilities of LLM-powered agents to conduct in-depth, adaptive and comprehensive alignment assessments on LLMs.
target_domain.note: LLM alignment red-teaming; web browsing (search) optional.

open_source.note: LICENSE file present in tree but contents not shown; README badge says MIT.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: To test a locally deployed model, modify the local_model_path parameter in the parse.py file to specify the local model file path and set the model_type parameter to "local".
model_agnostic.note: Core model GPT-4 via OpenAI key; target LLMs varied. No litellm abstraction evidenced.

primary_artifact.note: Repo likely frozen to paper (NeurIPS 2024); paper could also be argued.

first_release_date.note: No tag or first-commit date in evidence; paper arXiv 2405.14125 (v3 7 Nov 2024).
